scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U fishdict -d fishdict
scripts.db:cedict: node db/import-cedict.mjs | docker compose exec -T db psql -U fishdict -d fishdict -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
scripts.db:english: node db/import-english.mjs | docker compose exec -T db psql -U fishdict -d fishdict -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
scripts.db:dump: docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U fishdict -d fishdict --clean --if-exists --no-owner --no-privileges > db/dump.sql
scripts.db:restore: docker compose exec -T db psql -U fishdict -d fishdict -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/dump.sql
